snapshot.protocol_note: No fitting, threshold tuning or GT in inference. Same signed BAND, per-camera NMS and dense stereo points/covariances. Remove one hard gate, not its ranking term. geometry_math.note: Exact common orientation pinhole coordinates from actual centres; no detector errors/distortion inversion. Synthetic rays X/Z=-.3,0,.3 and Y/Z=-.1,0,.1; sampled bound only, NOT measured depth accuracy.
